name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1
summary: This EA trades based on the Fisher_org_v1 custom indicator, which produces a main line and a signal line. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Fisher_org_v1自定义指标进行交易，该指标生成主线和信号线。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，当主线从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理方式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Fisher_org_v1指标的双线交叉策略，主线(Ind)和信号线(Sign)的交叉作为交易信号。入场条件：当主线大于信号线且前一根K线主线小于等于信号线时，产生买入信号；当主线小于信号线且前一根K线主线大于等于信号线时，产生卖出信号。出场条件通过反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。EA还使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时利用LoadHistory函数确保历史数据加载完整。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-line crossover strategy using the Fisher_org_v1 indicator, where crossovers between the main line (Ind) and signal line (Sign) generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the main line is above the signal line and the previous bar's main line was at or below the signal line; a sell signal triggers when the main line is below the signal line and the previous bar's main line was at or above the signal line. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse crossover signals for position closure, complemented by fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) settings. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for the proportion and the MMMode parameter for the calculation method. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar period, preventing duplicate trades, and utilizes the LoadHistory function to ensure complete historical data loading.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot value

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal reading (0=current, 1=last completed)

pros: 使用新K线检测机制(IsNewBar)，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易者的风险偏好和账户规模
买卖方向开关独立可控，可单独禁用买入或卖出，适应不同市场观点
止损止盈参数完整，且止盈大于止损(2:1盈亏比)，具备正期望值潜力
使用Fisher指标基于价格变换，对市场极值有较好的敏感性
pros_en: Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Supports multiple money management modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences and account sizes
Buy and sell direction switches are independently controllable, allowing selective enabling/disabling
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, offering positive expectancy potential
Fisher indicator is based on price transformation, providing good sensitivity to market extremes
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能导致不利成交，尤其在低时间周期上更严重
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓导致仓位过重
止损1000点和止盈2000点相对较大，对市场波动适应性不足，未使用动态止损
依赖自定义指标Fisher_org_v1，若指标文件缺失则EA完全无法运行
SignalBar=1意味着信号延迟一根K线确认，可能导致入场时机偏晚错过部分利润
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may cause unfavorable fills during high spread conditions, especially on lower timeframes
No position count check, potentially leading to repeated same-direction entries and overexposure
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP are relatively large and lack adaptability to market volatility without dynamic stops
Depends on the custom Fisher_org_v1 indicator; if the indicator file is missing, the EA fails entirely
SignalBar=1 means signal confirmation is delayed by one bar, potentially causing late entries and missed profit
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量检查，防止高滑点和过度仓位风险
添加移动止损(Trailing Stop)功能，在盈利时锁定利润而非仅依赖固定止盈
增加指标加载失败的详细错误日志和自动重试机制，提升健壮性
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and maximum position count checks to prevent high slippage and overexposure risks
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in profits during favorable moves rather than relying solely on fixed take profit
Add detailed error logging for indicator load failures and an automatic retry mechanism to improve robustness

risk_points: 无持仓数量限制，可能在趋势行情中重复开仓导致仓位过重
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动变化，在剧烈波动时可能止损过小或止盈过大
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时无容错处理
risk_points_en: No position count limit, potentially leading to overexposure through repeated same-direction entries during trending markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to changing market volatility, potentially being too tight or too loose
Dependency on external custom indicator with no fallback handling when the indicator fails to load
